name: AICTE 2018 example cap on knowledge questions
description: At most 40% of marks on knowledge-oriented (Remember) questions. AICTE's Examination Reform Policy (2018, pp. 22-23) gives this as an example: "upper limit need to be arrived for lower order skills (for example, no more than 40% weightage for knowledge-oriented questions)" and notes that the weightage "can also vary from course to course". It is not a fixed rule.

name: Balanced undergraduate paper (illustrative)
description: An editable template, not an official rule: lower-order (Remember + Understand) at most 40%, application and analysis at least 40%, and evaluation and creation at least 10% of marks. Similar splits appear in several university OBE guidelines; set your own institution's numbers.
